278260305_f85055a8.text: Corticotropin-releasing factor CRF is produced by neurons in the PVN. Release of CRF participates in the stress response by initiating activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis, a process that emerges after animals encounter diverse aversive stimuli [100]. CRF-containing neurons integrate inputs from upstream sensory and aversive hubs and relay signals to downstream circuits that participate in various behavioral responses.
